description: This file contains utility enumerations and functions related to processing and unwrapping environment invocation commands within an OpenClaw application. It handles command parsing, environment variable assignments, and command resolution, indicating its role in command execution management for the app.

classes.name: ExecCommandToken
classes.description: Provides utility functions for processing command tokens, such as extracting lowercase basenames.

classes.name: ExecEnvInvocationUnwrapper
classes.description: Contains logic for unwrapping and resolving environment call wrappers in command arrays, including functions to handle transparent env invocations and nested wrappers.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Returns the lowercased base filename from a token, after trimming whitespace and replacing backslashes.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token matches the pattern of an environment variable assignment.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Simplifies a command array by unwrapping environment wrappers, returning the core command if possible.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps environment wrappers and gathers metadata such as whether modifiers are used.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested 'env' dispatch wrappers for command resolution.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Removes transparent env calls, returning the command after env-related tokens.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps transparent env dispatch wrappers for command resolution.
